items.title: Scope private endpoint updates and deletes to HorizonDB clusters
items.summary: The ARM private endpoint CustomPatchAsync and DeleteAsync applications now explicitly supply HorizonDbCluster as parent and PrivateEndpointConnectionResource as connection type. Both operations move below clusters/{clusterName} and require clusterName in the existing 2026-01-20-preview projection; update also changes its generated response and final-result type. These are connection update/delete lifecycle operations, not new cluster operations. The supplied delete response override is preserved. Unresolved common-type REST references and ambiguous ResourceListResult SDK identities prevent a complete compatibility conclusion.
